text: Because conversion carries a threat of loss and implicit dilution of stock holdings, contingent capital reduces shareholders' incentive to push management toward higher risk in pursuit of higher returns.
citation: Christoph K. Henkel, Wulf A. Kaal, Contingent Capital in European Union Bank Restructuring (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2061166

isBasedOn.name: Contingent Capital in European Union Bank Restructuring

abstract: Moreover, given the threat of loss due to conversion and the implicit dilution of stock holdings, contingent capital has the potential to reduce incentives for shareholders to encourage management to take higher risks for higher returns.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: conversion terms that dilute existing equity holders
